How AI selects a B2B law firm: matter fit, authority and verifiable expertise

Alexey YakovlevUpdated 9 November 2026

A business seeks counsel for a specific matter, not necessarily the most famous lawyer. A reliable AI recommendation should align the assignment with expertise, jurisdiction, team capacity and supported claims.

Discuss your projectSee the service

Evaluate a law firm against the actual matter: service scope, named practitioners, any claimed advocate status, applicable experience and engagement terms.

Start with the matter, not a generic league table

A corporate buyer brings constraints: dispute stage, jurisdiction, risk exposure, timing and industry. A broad reputation score does not prove that a provider can handle a particular tax matter or transaction.

Distinguish the law firm, an individual practitioner and the team responsible for the engagement. An answer can correctly identify the firm but invent a specialization for a partner.

  • Matter: contracts, corporate disputes, taxation, insolvency or M&A.
  • Role: advisory, representation, negotiation or litigation.
  • Jurisdiction and geography; remote versus on-site execution.
  • Conflicts, confidentiality and engagement documentation.

Five example unbranded business questions

These prompts are templates for a future audit, not outputs of a performed test. Adapt each to the firm actual services and clients.

A generic best-lawyers query can be a benchmark, but a decision-maker needs qualified recommendations for particular matters.

  • Which firms advise on buying a stake in a Russian company and related corporate restrictions?
  • Who can represent a supplier in a contract dispute at the current procedural stage?
  • How should a company choose tax counsel for an upcoming audit?
  • Who advises directors on potential subsidiary liability?
  • How can I verify the legal entity and claimed advocate status of a suggested firm?

The advocate register and legal entity data

In Russia the general term lawyer and the regulated status of advocate are not interchangeable. If a practitioner claims advocate status, check an applicable public record in the Ministry of Justice register rather than assuming it from a job title.

Federal Tax Service registries can corroborate the legal entity. Such checks do not establish litigation skill, integrity or guaranteed success.

  • Match registered legal name and identifiers to the website.
  • Check advocate status only when it is specifically claimed.
  • Separate regulated advocacy from general consultancy.
  • Do not infer case outcomes from a registry entry.

Evidence of practice without breaching confidentiality

A matter description may disclose the scope, role and an authorized outcome. Public case documents do not necessarily permit disclosure of privileged client materials or the terms of a private engagement.

Where permission is absent, describe the service workflow, team qualifications, engagement boundaries and public professional materials without fabricating case wins.

  • Explain the provider actual role in the engagement.
  • Disclose client, date and outcome only when permitted.
  • Distinguish court-public information from confidential business data.
  • Verify permission to use names, quotations and results.

Rate the recommendation, not merely the mention

A firm name in an answer does not prove a qualified recommendation. Record whether the provider fits the matter, whether the stated professional status is correct and which sources support the choice.

For repeated GEO measurement, keep the same prompts, interfaces and denominator. Ambiguous and failed answers need explicit handling instead of being counted as successes.

  • Branded recognition.
  • Unbranded mention for a defined legal matter.
  • Qualified recommendation with supported practice fit.
  • Incorrect status, jurisdiction or fabricated case experience.

Frequently asked questions

How should a company assess law-firm fit?+
Match the matter, procedure, jurisdiction, named team and verifiable scope of work.
Must every legal consultant appear in the advocates register?+
No. The register concerns people with advocate status; other legal service providers require appropriate alternative checks.
Can a court decision be reused freely in a client case study?+
Publication requires attention to client confidentiality, role and disclosure rights beyond the public status of the decision.
How can law-firm AI recommendations be measured?+
Track mentions, verified matter fit and errors separately, using a stable set of prompts and interfaces.
Does this demonstrate new client results?+
No. It is a buyer-intent evidence framework without newly claimed client outcomes.
